dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Patience is the key to solving problems... as is ensuring safety.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Hello there. Welcome to the Flower-Feather Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: As the chief, I don't want to seem too strict or lay too many rules down, but living here does take a little care and patience.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: The Qucusaurus is the proudest Saurian in Natlan, as are many of their riders.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: But once they're in battle, people soon discover that arrogance is no help in attaining victory.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Scars may be a warrior's badge of honor, but they're also a reminder of mistakes made.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry. Have I been blabbing on too long? What I meant to say is: Please be extra careful.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you guys. Welcome. I trust that you're in good health, or are you suffering any aftereffects from the Abyss?

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for helping us when we were short-handed. If it weren't for you, our tribe would never have recovered so soon.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Despite the threat of the Abyss having abated, there will always be danger lurking somewhere in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: But you can't just rush in headfirst at any cost just because you're tough, okay? That's the easiest way for a warrior to make a mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Learning to fly takes guts, but you also need keen eyesight.

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Being blind to your surroundings is your biggest enemy while you're up in the air.
